title: 第9章 国营饭店第10章 野猪换物资
content_zh:
张昊宇乐颠颠地跑到“供销社”，一进门就冲着柜台里的女售货员，“同志，你们领导在不在呀？”
女售货员瞅了他一眼，“你找我们主任干啥呀？”
张昊宇挠挠头，“我爷爷家住的村子里，有个猎人让我来问问，你们收不收野猪啊？”
女售货员一听“野猪”俩字，眼睛立马亮了，喜笑颜开地，“收啊！”
其他几个售货员也呼啦一下围了过来，七嘴八舌地，“收收收，肯定收啊，谁不要谁是傻子！”
张昊宇赶紧摆摆手，“大家别激动，野猪是有条件的，一是价格，二是要换物品。要是你们达不到条件，那也白搭！”
“行，我带你去找主任！”张昊宇跟着女售货员来到办公室，“主任，这小同志问我们收不收野猪！”
主任是个四十来岁的中年人，一听“野猪”，“噌”地一下就站起来了。
急切地问：“野猪？在哪儿呢？”
女售货员白了他一眼，“主任，你急啥呀？条件都还没谈好呢，猪毛你都看不到！”
这会主任也冷静下来了，“小同志，你有野猪啊？多大的呀？”
“主任您好，我是帮村里的猎人问的，看看你们收野猪啥价格，还得换物品！”
主任想了想，“价格嘛，市场价两毛多一斤，加上肉票五毛左右，黑市价格是一块左右一斤，我们能给一块钱一斤！”
“谢谢主任了，那我先回去跟猎人说一声。”
说完，他转身就往外走。
张昊宇走到前厅，又被几个售货员给拦住了，她们迫不及待地问：“同志，谈好了吗？野猪啥时候送过来呀？”
张昊宇嘴角一扬，笑道：“你们领导给的价钱，野猪怕是送不过来了！”
这时，主任也追了出来，“小同志，我们再谈谈，价钱好商量嘛！”
张昊宇连忙摆手：“主任同志，我就是帮着问问，把价格告诉他们，我的任务就完成了！我可没有谈价钱的权力！”
一个男售货员好奇地问：“同志，你说说主任给的啥价格？”

张昊宇伸出一根手指：“一块钱！”几个售货员一听，顿时眼睛瞪得浑圆，带着杀气看向主任。
男售货员看着主任，没好气地说：“赵姨，沙武进，我们以后想吃肉怕是难咯！
我回去得让我舅舅把我调走！我们家都三四个月没吃过肉了！我那宝贝女儿都快瘦成照片了！”
沙武进附和道：“朱霸杰，你要是能让你舅舅把我也调走！你女儿就算瘦成照片，我也让我儿子把你女儿挂我家墙上！”
朱霸杰没好气地，“去你的！我女儿凭啥要挂你家墙上？不对！你女儿才挂墙上呢！”
张昊宇忍不住笑出了声，“对不起啊，没忍住……”
朱霸杰看着张昊宇，“兄弟，我去找我舅舅，你说说有啥条件。
我舅舅昨天在我家，还在为肉发愁呢！他说有人三块钱一斤，买到一头五六十斤的野猪，把他羡慕得不行！
他说现在啊，肉不能用市场价来衡量，甚至不能用钱来衡量！
钱买不到的东西，钱就不是钱了！长期没有油水，身体会出问题的！
再说了，我们供销社系统买野猪，根本不花国家的钱，都是员工自己出钱买。
野味又不是计划内物资，单位有采购权，买到以后内部价分给员工，合理合法！”
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu ran to the "Supply and Marketing Cooperative" happily. As soon as he entered the door, he asked the saleswoman at the counter, "Comrade, is your leader here?"
The saleswoman glanced at him and said, "What are you doing with our director?"
Zhang Haoyu scratched his head and said, "In the village where my grandfather lives, a hunter asked me to ask if you would collect wild boars?"
When the saleswoman heard the word "wild boar", her eyes immediately lit up and she beamed, "Take it!"
Several other salesmen also cheered and gathered around, all talking, "Take it, take it, take it, definitely take it, whoever doesn't want it is a fool!"
Zhang Haoyu quickly waved his hand, "Don't get excited, everyone, the wild boar has conditions, one is the price, and the other is the need to exchange items. If you can't meet the conditions, it's all in vain!"
"Okay, I'll take you to the director!" Zhang Haoyu followed the saleswoman to the office, "Director, this little comrade asked us if we will accept wild boars!"
The director is a middle-aged man in his forties. When he heard "wild boar", he stood up immediately.
Asked eagerly: "Wild boar? Where is it?"
The saleswoman rolled her eyes at him, "Director, what are you in a hurry for? The terms haven't been negotiated yet, and you can't even see the pig hair!"
The director also calmed down at this moment, "Comrade, do you have a wild boar? How big is it?"
"Hello, director, I'm here to ask for help from the hunters in the village. Let's see what price you charge for wild boars, and you have to exchange items for them!"
The director thought for a while and said, "As for the price, the market price is more than 20 cents per catty, plus the meat coupon is about 50 cents, the black market price is about 1 yuan per catty, we can give you 1 yuan per catty!"
"Thank you, director. I'll go back and talk to the hunter first."
After saying that, he turned around and walked out.
Zhang Haoyu walked to the front hall and was stopped by several salesmen. They couldn't wait to ask: "Comrade, are the talks settled? When will the wild boar be delivered?"
Zhang Haoyu raised the corner of his mouth and said with a smile: "The price given by your leader, I'm afraid the wild boar won't be able to deliver it!"
At this time, the director also chased me out, "Comrade, let's talk about it again. The price can be easily negotiated!"
Zhang Haoyu waved his hand quickly: "Comrade Director, I just asked them and told them the price. My task is completed! I have no right to negotiate the price!"
A male salesperson asked curiously: "Comrade, can you tell me what price the director gave me?"
Zhang Haoyu stretched out a finger: "One dollar!" Upon hearing this, several salesmen suddenly widened their eyes and looked at the director with murderous intent.
The male salesperson looked at the director and said angrily: "Aunt Zhao, Sha Wujin, I'm afraid it will be difficult for us to eat meat in the future!
I have to ask my uncle to transfer me when I go back! Our family hasn’t eaten meat in three or four months! My baby girl is almost as thin as a picture! "
Sha Wujin echoed: "Zhu Bajie, if you can ask your uncle to transfer me too! Even if your daughter is as thin as a picture, I will let my son hang your daughter on the wall of my house!"
Zhu Bajie said angrily, "Fuck you! Why should my daughter hang it on your wall? No! Your daughter is the only one hanging it on the wall!"
Zhang Haoyu couldn't help laughing, "I'm sorry, I couldn't help it..."
Zhu Bajie looked at Zhang Haoyu and said, "Brother, I'm going to find my uncle and you can tell me what the conditions are.
My uncle was at my house yesterday and was still worried about meat! He said that someone bought a fifty or sixty-pound wild boar for three yuan a pound, which made him extremely envious!
He said that now, meat cannot be measured by market price, or even by money!
If money can't buy something, money is no longer money! If there is no oil and water for a long time, your body will have problems!
Besides, when our supply and marketing cooperative system buys wild boars, it doesn’t cost the state at all. The employees pay for them themselves.
Game is not a planned material. The unit has the right to purchase it. After purchasing it, it will be distributed to employees at an internal price. It is reasonable and legal! "
